decision: advance to full production validation: directed widths restore all twelve failing query rows, avoid unnecessary range saturation, and integer keys remove the previously measured ordinary-query regressions
resource_gate_scope: Early resource gate after focused validation; full production suites and report replay remain required before admission. Five fresh alternating processes per variant/mode on CPU 0 after 100 ms integer-only conditioning. Timing uses the system allocator; memory binaries separately count requested Rust allocations. Each exact full private index implementation is extracted verbatim and linked to its frozen production library; the private bounds wrapper is represented by the public STRICT wrapper. Ten prepared point workloads measure index construction, first, repeated and cloned-point queries. Point producer construction and query clones are outside measurement; selected-point certified equality checks run after measured queries. Independent box-overlap and known-point witnesses check every candidate output, including zero-endpoint and symmetric conservative false-positive saturation controls. Incorrect baseline omissions remain recorded as correctness deltas. This is an index microbenchmark, not complete public Boolean performance or an application speedup claim.

measured_libraries_retained.scope: Copies made after all resource trials completed, before any further Cargo command, to preserve measured library bytes if later validation changes top-level build outputs. The executed manifest and logs are unchanged.

resource_review.unchanged_controls: All 28 unchanged witness rows preserve all four allocation metrics, with five identical memory samples. Their timing ratios range from 0.8635 to 1.1704, with median 0.9912; no uniform speedup is claimed.
resource_review.previous_ordinary_regressions: The fresh matched ratios for exact_sparse_cloned and exact_crowded_first are 0.9131 and 0.9941. This resolves the two controls that delayed the previous candidate; it is not a separately matched causal comparison against that candidate.
resource_review.unfavorable_samples: The MAX-width first-query median is 17.0% slower (385.4 to 451.1 ns/query), with broadly overlapping samples. Other unchanged medians regress by at most 5.9%, with overlapping sample ranges. All unfavorable samples are retained.
resource_review.restored_output_cost: Corrected queries allocate their required candidate vectors: 32 retained bytes for a singleton or 512 retained bytes for 64 contacts. These outputs were incorrectly absent in the baseline.
resource_review.binary_cost: Standalone probe ELF size increases by 392 bytes for timing and 424 bytes for allocation accounting.
resource_review.scope: The exactness repair is the intended benefit. Full application validation and report preservation still gate admission.

next_step: Review the full matched samples, then run complete production validation and report replay before admission.
